summary: HOLD: 1 manuscript(s) produced 13 finding(s): 2 critical, 8 high, 3 warning, and 2 research gap prompt(s).

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split/rf-heat-risk has train/test samples only 0.6 km apart without spatial blocking.
findings.evidence: Policy requires at least 35 km or explicit spatial block validation.
findings.remediation: Use spatial block, leave-site-out, or regional holdout validation and regenerate performance claims.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split/rf-heat-risk tunes model choices on the test/holdout set.
findings.evidence: Reviewer-facing performance claims require a locked final test set.
findings.remediation: Move tuning to inner validation folds and rerun the locked test set once.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split is missing reproducibility artifact dataManifest.
findings.evidence: Geospatial results depend on data, code, and environment parity.
findings.remediation: Attach a data manifest with sample ids, coordinates, split labels, and hashes.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split is missing reproducibility artifact environmentSpec.
findings.evidence: Geospatial results depend on data, code, and environment parity.
findings.remediation: Attach a pinned environment or container digest for spatial libraries.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split/rf-heat-risk fits spatial preprocessing on the full dataset.
findings.evidence: Raster normalization, imputation, or feature selection must be learned inside each training fold.
findings.remediation: Refit preprocessing inside training folds and attach fold-specific transformation hashes.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split/rf-heat-risk reports Moran's I 0.62 with a random split.
findings.evidence: High spatial autocorrelation inflates random train/test validation.
findings.remediation: Run spatial block cross-validation or leave-region-out validation before presenting performance as reviewer-ready.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split does not declare a coordinate reference system.
findings.evidence: Spatial distances, joins, and raster overlays cannot be reviewed without CRS evidence.
findings.remediation: Declare the source CRS/EPSG code and any analysis projection used for distance or area operations.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split/rf-heat-risk lacks external spatial validation for broader deployment claims.
findings.evidence: Broad geographic or deployment claims should be checked outside the training geography.
findings.remediation: Add an out-of-region validation site or limit the manuscript claim to the sampled geography.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split makes a broad geographic claim with only 1 observed region(s).
findings.evidence: The model generalizes across continental urban heat islands.
findings.remediation: Limit the claim to sampled regions or add external validation sites covering the claimed geography.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split exposes sensitive locations at 6 decimal places.
findings.evidence: Human-subject or protected-species locations should be generalized before reviewer packets or public summaries.
findings.remediation: Round or jitter coordinates to 4 decimals or provide an approved restricted-location access path.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split/rf-heat-risk covariate NDVI has no source citation or artifact id.
findings.evidence: Raster/vector covariates should be traceable for reproducibility and recency review.
findings.remediation: Attach a source DOI, artifact id, or repository path for each spatial covariate.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split has spatial validation claims without a block map artifact.
findings.evidence: Reviewers need the held-out geometry or block map to audit leakage.
findings.remediation: Attach a block-map artifact id, geometry hash, or leave-site-out manifest.

findings.message: urban-heat-random-split/rf-heat-risk covariate NDVI spans 540 acquisition days.
findings.evidence: Long covariate windows can hide temporal drift in geospatial models.
findings.remediation: Use period-matched covariates or report temporal-drift sensitivity checks.

researchGapOpportunities.title: Prioritize out-of-region replication before broad geographic claims
researchGapOpportunities.rationale: urban-heat-random-split samples 1 region(s), below the 3-region policy for broad claims.
researchGapOpportunities.firstAction: Recruit or simulate a holdout site in the least represented claimed region.

researchGapOpportunities.title: Add spatial block validation benchmark
researchGapOpportunities.rationale: High autocorrelation with random validation means reported accuracy may be optimistic.
researchGapOpportunities.firstAction: Create a leave-region-out benchmark and compare it to the random split baseline.
